fit_reason: Whole passenger car, a 2009 Chevy Cobalt sedan, listed by a private owner.
findings: Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on both front headlights
Driver floor mat looks dirty and dusty with debris
Dust and grime on the driver door sill and lower door jamb
Red paint looks somewhat flat on the rear quarter and trunk lid in the rear three-quarter shot
Light dust on the dash and center console area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the red Cobalt. The headlights look pretty hazy in the front photo and the driver floor and door sill could use a cleanup, both easy things that make a car show better to buyers. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight restoration and a wash and wax, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
